description: This file contains the Affiliate controller class for the OpenCart admin module. It manages affiliate-related functionalities including listing, editing, enabling/disabling, deleting, generating CSV payouts, reporting, and autocomplete features within the marketing section of the admin panel.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing affiliates in the OpenCart admin panel, providing features for CRUD operations, status toggling, CSV export, reporting, and autocomplete functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the affiliate list page, initialize filters, breadcrumbs, and load the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to get the list of affiliates, returning the HTML content.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles the affiliates data, including pagination, filters, and links, and renders the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an affiliate, pre-populating fields if editing an existing affiliate.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving affiliate data submitted from the form, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected affiliates, changing their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected affiliates, changing their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected affiliates from the system.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates balances for all active affiliates based on transactions.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Generates a CSV payout file for selected affiliates, initiating a file download.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Marks selected affiliates as paid by adding a transaction and resetting their balance.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays detailed reports for an affiliate, including recent activity.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches report data for an affiliate with pagination and renders the report view.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete list of affiliates for search inputs based on name or email.
